cut_contour.note: Proposal. The print PDF has no cut line: choose straight or rounded corners at the printer.

production.format: 140 x 280 mm (width x height), 3 mm bleed; PDF 146 x 286 mm. Width to be checked against the front face of the door post (the current round sticker is about as wide as the post).
production.material: Self adhesive foil, laminated (outdoor), on the door post directly above the exit button

notes: New design asked by the parking host for a pedestrian door that opens with a push button: replaces a third party 'Push' sticker. PY-Blauw face, white bubble (py-atom-shape-bubble-solid) with a drawn mushroom button pictogram and press arrow, heading 'Druk op de knop', aqua line 'om de deur te openen', English in medium italic as on the terminal stickers ('Druk 3 seconden'), and the route arrow (py-atom-arrow-up-circle, turned down) pointing at the button below the sticker.
